source.author: aDd1kTeD2Ka0s

notes: New acquisition route (not a measured yield cohort): Ka0s Loot History advertises separate Disenchant, Milling and Prospecting output-source labels plus History CSV export, but no publicly available player CSV/source cohort was located. Output attribution alone does not prove exact source input itemLink, successful completed casts, material zero outcomes, profession skill/spec or Resourcefulness basis. A second addon Playfulls advertises local day/build-tagged disenchant-derived records, but no public player data or verified event-level pairing was located. Do not use addons' descriptions or examples as observed drop statistics; obtain consented original logs and validate exact per-cast pairing/zero capture before import.
lookingFor: First-party, publicly published current Midnight or Season 2 per-operation raw exported logs from Miststalker's Wristbands, rare/epic gear disenchanting, Umbral Tin Ore/Refulgent Copper/Brilliant Silver prospecting and Tranquility Bloom milling, including exact inputItemLink and zero-inclusive output
